sources.entry: Conferences.digital - Best way to watch the latest and greatest videos from your favourite developer conferences for free on your Mac.

summary.one_liner: A free macOS app for browsing, searching, and watching videos from developer conferences, with a watchlist and progress tracking.
summary.what_it_does: Conferences.digital lets you search for conferences, talks, speakers, or topics, or browse the catalog of developer conference videos. You can add talks to a watchlist, mark favourites, and resume where you left off. The README says new conferences and talks are announced on Twitter. Updates are delivered through Sparkle. The app is written in Swift 5 and supports macOS 10.12.2 and later.
use_cases: watch developer conference talks on a Mac
search conference videos by speaker or topic
keep a watchlist of talks to watch later
resume conference videos where you left off
browse a catalog of tech conference recordings
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the GitHub releases page linked in the README.
Open the app. If macOS blocks it as from an unidentified developer, right-click the app and choose Open, or allow it under System Preferences > Security & Privacy.
notable: Watchlist and favourites for saving talks
Search across conferences, talks, speakers, and topics
Announces new conferences and talks on Twitter
caveats: Not signed with an Apple developer ID, so first launch requires a manual security override
Not on the Mac App Store; the README says the project is early-stage and a work in progress
